messages:
Sam (People Ops): Quick heads-up 1 new hires Mon 09:00 (SF desk) + 2 remote (one UK). One SF hire has an I-9 supporting-doc exception (needs passport). Need kiosk escort, courier for welcome packs, and local notary for the UK hire. Who can pick up badge escort?
Devon R: I can do SF escort 08:50. Please drop the final arrival list here.
IT-OPS: Imaging for 2 laptops finishing tonight. We'll tag as ONB-SF-03/ONB-SF-04 and place in onboarding rack. Any VPN pre-provision requests?
Sam (People Ops): Yes, SF engineer needs temp admin for installs (basic-admin, 5d). Add auto-revoke. Remote UK hire doesn't need admin.
BadgeBot: Badge print queue: 2 ready, 1 on hold due to e-verify. Template: Onboard-Nameplate. ETA print start 08:45.
CourierBot: Courier booked AM-07:00, label 'onboard-urgent'. Leave kits with front desk; include notary envelope for UK parcel.
NotaryVendor: UK notary booked 10:30 BST (NotarizeLocal). I'll DM calendar invite to the hire and Sam.
Security: Lobby hold OK 08:40-09:10. We'll need to verify passport for I-9 exception at desk.
Sam (People Ops): Thanks all. Devon, can you meet Notary at kiosk if they swing by SF? If courier confirms pickup tonight I will post final morning runbook at 07:30. :white_check_mark:
